jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving 

For our client, an international company who produces frozen potato products, we are looking for production operators in 2 shifts.

What does your job responsibility involve?

 
• 
You will be responsible for setting up and starting up the machine

 
• 
You are responsible for converting and operating the production lines

 
• 
You ensure that the packaging lines work optimally and make adjustments where necessary

 
• 
You solve minor malfunctions or provide correct information to technical colleagues

 
• 
You carry out the necessary checks

 
• 
You have an eye for quality while performing your job

 
• 
You have a strong interest in technology

 
• 
You have technical insight and are quality-conscious

 
• 
You can work independently but can also cooperate with colleagues

 
• 
You may be interested in mastering other tasks and responsibilities

 
• 
You preferably have an A2 education in a technical field or have a strong affinity for technology

 
• 
You have a strong knowledge of English,French of Nederlands

 
• 
You are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

As a packer at BNFW, you play an essential role in the process of preparing our products for shipment. 

You will work according to BNFW's quality standards to ensure that only the best products leave the facility.

Responsibilities:

• Carefully and efficiently packing fruit products according to guidelines.

• Checking the quality of the fruit and separating products that do not meet the standards.

• Ensuring the correct labeling and packaging of the products.

• Complying with hygiene and safety regulations in the workplace.

• Contributing to a clean and organized work environment.

What do we ask of you?

• An eye for detail and accuracy when performing tasks

• Physically capable of performing repetitive tasks and working in a standing position

• Willingness to work in a refrigerated environment

• Good knowledge of English

You are available to work in at least two of the following shifts:

• From 6u to 13u45

• From 8u to 15u45

• From 14u to 21u45

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business  

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Czech and Polish.

• Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team of approximately 12 professionals, including application analysts, developers, project managers, as well as a Salesforce Technical Architect and Release Manager.
• Foster a collaborative, motivated, and high-performing team culture while supporting the professional growth of each team member through effective coaching and development.
• Prioritize team activities and ensure the right balance between workload, resources, and business priorities.
• Own and manage the portfolio of customer-related IT projects, translating the company's Customer Strategy into a clear and actionable project roadmap.
• Work closely with business stakeholders and enterprise architects to define and communicate the future vision of the customer application domain.
• Ensure successful project delivery within agreed scope, budget, quality, and timelines.
• Oversee the maintenance, enhancement, and support of the applications within your domain, ensuring high availability and an excellent user experience.
• Organize and optimize the handling of incidents, change requests, and service requests in line with departmental processes and agreed service levels (SLAs).
• Proactively monitor the health and performance of business-critical applications.
• Provide functional leadership to the Salesforce Technical Architect and Release Manager, ensuring governance, consistency, knowledge sharing, and the adoption of best practices across all Salesforce teams.
• Manage the budgets and supplier contracts required to deliver your team's objectives.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and stay informed about emerging technologies and industry trends.

Profile

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Business, or another relevant scientific discipline.
• At least 5 years of experience managing application development teams or leading complex application projects.
• Proven experience delivering customer-facing digital solutions within an enterprise complex environment.
• Languages: French, Dutch and English
• Hands-on experience implementing or managing CRM solutions.
• Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and/or Field Service is a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with Enterprise Architect, JIRA, Planview, Omnitracker, and AI-driven solutions is considered a plus.
• You bring strong leadership and coaching skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills.

jobs.occupation: L3 Support / System Administrator | Growth & Hands-On IT
jobs.description:
A hands-on L3 role combining advanced support, systems and infrastructure : in a team where you can continuously develop your technical expertise.

What makes this opportunity stand out?You won’t be stuck doing repetitive tickets.You’ll work closely with experienced IT and infrastructure professionals, tackle increasingly complex technical challenges and have the opportunity toexpand your skills across different technologies.
L3 Support Engineer / System Administrator : The Job
• Own L3 supportfor complex incidents, troubleshooting issues across workstations, applications, operating systems and infrastructure.
• Administer Microsoft & Linux environments, handling user rights, configurations, deployments and day-to-day system administration tasks.
• Troubleshoot and supportnetworking, VPN, security and endpoint solutions, escalating more complex infrastructure issues when required.
• Managelaptops, desktops and Apple devices, including preparation, configuration and deployment.
• Maintain accurateCMDB and ticketing data, follow incidents through to resolution and contribute to improving processes and Knowledge Base documentation.
• Work closely with theIT & Infrastructure teamson projects, exceptional workloads and continuous improvements to the overall IT environment.
L3 Support Engineer / System Administrator : The Profile
• 5+ years of experiencein IT Support, System Administration or a similar technical role, ideally with L2/L3 exposure.
• Strong technical knowledge ofMicrosoft & Linux environments, with good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Comfortable working withnetworking, VPN, antivirus/security solutions and user access management.
• Experience withMicrosoft 365, Teams, Zoom and collaboration tools, as well as Apple environments such as macOS, iOS and iPadOS.
• Familiarity withprint management, audiovisual and conference-room technologiesis a plus.
• Ateam player with a growth mindset, strong communication skills and genuine curiosity for learning new technologies. Fluent inFrench and English.

A hands-on Senior Support role combining technical challenges, team spirit and international exposure.. with plenty of room to grow.

The real X-factor?You’ll know the people you work with, while working on technology used in an international environment.It’s a collaborative team where people work closely together, share knowledge and genuinely help each other grow.

 

Our partner is aBelgian technology scale-up with an international footprint, combining the close-knit culture of a growing local company with the complexity of a global environment. 
Senior Support Engineer - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Act as aSenior Support reference, taking ownership of complex incidents and ensuring issues are followed through to resolution.
• Provide advanced support acrossMicrosoft & Linux environments, endpoints, applications and user access.
• Troubleshootnetworking, VPN and security-related issues, while supporting basic infrastructure and server activities.
• Manage and configurelaptops, desktops and Apple devices, including deployments and technical maintenance.
• Contribute toIT processes & continuous improvement, including CMDB updates, ticketing, reporting and Knowledge Base documentation.
• Collaborate closely withIT & Infrastructure teams, sharing knowledge and supporting the team during high workloads and technical projects.
Senior Support Engineer - Your Profile
• 4+ years of experiencein IT Support, with solid L2/L3 or senior-level exposure.
• Strong knowledge ofMicrosoft & Linux, combined with excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
• Good understanding ofnetworking, VPN, antivirus/security solutions and user access management.
• Experience withMicrosoft 365, Teams, Zoom and Apple environmentssuch as macOS, iOS and iPadOS.
• Knowledge ofprint management, audiovisual and conference-room technologiesis a strong plus.
• A genuineteam playerwith strong communication skills, resilience and a curiosity for learning and evolving technically.
• Fluent inFrench and English.

This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French and Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

You coordinate and supervise the production, the team, and the workload in our central production kitchen. This kitchen supplies our locations in Antwerp, Brussels, Ghent, and various events.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

•  

You organize task distribution, provide guidelines, and manage the kitchen team during bulk production, cooking, packaging, and finishing.
  

•  

Processing and monitoring orders from all outlets.
  

•  

Placing orders with various suppliers.
  

•  

Managing inventory, determining needs, and following up on orders.
  

•  

Creating daily, weekly, and monthly planning for cooking and deliveries.
  

•  

Preparing the kitchen staff schedules.
  

•  

Coordinating task distribution between the day kitchen and the evening shift.
  

•  

Maintaining a clean and orderly working environment and handling kitchen equipment with care.
  

•  

Working in compliance with safety regulations.
  

•  

Monitoring safety and hygiene standards during operations, including food safety, correct labeling, and proper storage in accordance with HACCP standards.
  

•  

Supervising the maintenance of the kitchen, ventilation hoods, and all equipment, in coordination with the cleaning team and other service providers.
  

•  

Communicating with and reporting weekly to the overarching management team
  
 

•  

Minimum of 10 years of experience as a chef.
  

•  

Experience managing multiple outlets and in similar leadership roles.
  

•  

Knowledge of Indian cuisine is required.
  

•  

Strong knowledge of HACCP standards and consistent application thereof.
  

•  

Fluent in spoken and written English.
  

•  

Good computer skills (Excel & Word).
  

•  

A team player who approaches problems quickly and practically.
